{{Quote|No one's ever honored me my entire life, except when I'm transporting something they want. I honor the smuggler's code&mdash;"Get paid as much as possible.".|Rook Pryce|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''Rook Pryce''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. He gained a reputation as being untrustworthy that no one would sell anything to him. [[Shon Ti'Ja]], one of the crime bosses on the planet, even attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.<ref name="SC" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] Pryce was on Wielu while [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was chasing the criminal [[T'mott Zoat]]. Pryce tripped Zoat, helping Kenobi to capture him. Pryce then offered to take Kenobi and his captive to [[Helleguth]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Stellar Haze]]'', but Pryce released Zoat after being bribed with four hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Later, Pryce followed Kenobi to Wielu's jungle, where Zoat had gone. Pryce said he owed Kenobi, and he became his guide. They tracked Zoat to Boss Traygura's base, where Pryce betrayed Kenobi and gave him to Boss Traygura, in exchange for becoming her personal smuggler. Pryce was captured when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Skirmish at Traygura’s Hideout|rescued]] Kenobi.<ref name="SC" />
